triage.kind_span: This Amendment No. 2 is the final amendment to the Schedule TO and is being filed (i) to report the final results of the Exchange Offer

subject_names.span: The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust, a Delaware statutory trust (GDV or the Issuer)

subject_tickers.span: The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust (NYSE:GDV) (the Fund)

security_class.span: Auction Market Preferred Shares, Series B, Par Value $0.001

price_basis.span: based upon a price of 96% of the liquidation preference of $25,000 per share (or $24,000 per share)

size_pct_outstanding.span: relating to the Issuers offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares

size_shares.span: Calculated as the aggregate maximum purchase price to be paid for 6,371 shares in the exchange offer

commencement_date.span: Under the terms of the Offer, which commenced March 17, 2021 and expired April 14, 2021

expiration_date.span: The Exchange Offer expired at 5:00 p.m. New York City time, on April 14, 2021.

shares_tendered.span: 6,105 Auction Rate Preferred Shares were validly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the expiration of the Exchange Offer

shares_accepted.span: all 6,105 Auction Rate Preferred Shares, representing 95.8% of the outstanding Auction Rate Preferred Shares on the Expiration Date, were accepted for exchange

notes: Exchange offer of auction rate preferred shares for Series J term preferred plus cash (0.96 Series J share per auction share), not an offer priced on NAV, so price_basis is other and price_pct_nav null. The amendment says 6,105 shares were tendered and accepted; the attached press release says 6,106 were tendered. The amendment figure is used. The transaction valuation uses 6,371 shares (maximum if all outstanding were tendered), taken as size_shares; the offer was for up to 100%. No cash price per share is stated. Fund type taken from the press release (diversified, closed-end management investment company).
